item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.10.5.105
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.10.5.105
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 13:17:05 -0500
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ### 3.10.5

#200: measureInputOffset honors "channels" (1-based; empty = all). Only the listed AO channels are zeroed according to "zero" (both, ac, dc, none) and only the listed AI channels get a new InputOffset; other channels are left unchanged. Fixes the empty-list case, which skipped the wait for the outputs to reach zero, and channel numbers above the AO count, which could stall the measurement until the timeout.

#199 (part 1): internal reorganization, mainly to speed up builds.
- Public typedefs (AO/AI/REF/Sweep/DAQ configuration, API command clusters) moved out of the Instrument.DAQ and Instrument.Lockin classes into a new class-free library, Lockin.Typedefs.lvlib, so code that uses them no longer loads the whole acquisition engine.
- Lockin.Utilities.lvlib moved out of Instrument.Lockin.lvlib.
- Test and sandbox VIs removed from the shipped classes (moved to Tests\ or deleted); Caraya is no longer a runtime dependency.
- Typedef labels are unchanged, so the JSON/ZMQ wire protocol is unchanged. Qualified names did change: LabVIEW code that links this package (e.g. Transport) must be relinked against this version.

item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.10.2.102
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.10.2.102
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:45:02 -0500
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ### 3.10.0

#191: Start no longer hangs on an empty or stale DAQ configuration; it reports an error, and AUTO configures the DAQ on Start
#192: AI/AO graph legends and plot visibility follow the channel count; Mean matches AI keys only
#193: Fs Output follows the fastest enabled REF (Auto) or a manual rate, with an Fs/#s floor; Auto/Manual selector in the UI
#194: AO-to-AI loopback phase is deterministic: AO and REF phases reset together, and the converter delay table uses NI's published delays plus measured corrections for each Fs band (USB-4431, PXI-4461), with band edges matching NI's tables
#195: output gain and offset arrays are sized to the AO channel count on every AO config change
Offsets: controls are moved to gain tab; users are warned that output values will change when measuring input offsets, indicator moved to main tab
Sampling rate and buffer size are now shown on main tab

### Phase accuracy:
following improvemnts under #194 the remaining internal delay is under half a sample (phase error at most 180°·f/Fs). Delays in external circuitry (amplifiers, filters, cables) are not compensated; zero the phase in your setup at your operating frequency and sample rate.

item.title: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.5.38
item.description:
Product: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.5.38
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:49:52 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Override library implementing ZMQ lazy pirate reliable request reply (RRR) protocal using RemoteControl SMO framework.

Release Notes: ### 1.5.5

A server (REP) now replies to a request that is not valid JSON instead of leaving the socket stuck (#9). The reply is a JSON-RPC 2.0 error: `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32700,"message":"Parse error"}}`. A request that is valid JSON but malformed (for example, missing or with an empty `method`) gets `-32600 Invalid Request`. In both cases the server keeps answering the requests that follow, so no restart is needed. Before this, a non-JSON request got no reply, and REQ/REP lockstep kept the server from answering anything else.
